title: Frontend: Tooltip
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Tooltip. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. A button named Help reveals a role=tooltip with text Extra help on focus or mouse hover. Associate aria-describedby=help-tip only while visible. Escape and blur hide it. Tooltip is supplemental plain text, with no interactive children.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Keep the trigger accessible without requiring the tooltip.
alternativeApproaches: Position the help near viewport edges without clipping or creating an interactive hover trap.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Hover; focus; Escape.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
